caption: Both branches read the same t = 0.3, so outline and colour move together: the control point travels from A(0, 0) to (30, 12) while the colours mix 0.7 of the source with 0.3 of the target. Feed the two branches different t values and the shape and its colour pull apart.

spec.title: One t for both jobs
spec.aria: A matched control pair A(0,0) and B(100,40) feeds two parallel branches that both use t = 0.3: a warp that puts the point at (30, 12) and a cross-dissolve weighing 0.7 of the source against 0.3 of the target, the two branches joining into the frame at t = 0.3.
